overview_description.description:
We are an all-in-one, comprehensive legal technology solutions provider to help your firm stay atop the competitive legal market, directing to take the legal industry to the next level with the implementation of technology and to overcome the challenges currently being faced, with a keen focus on our main industry transformer factors – Change, Scale, Focus and Connect.

With the importance of technology being recognized along with its increasing demand in the legal industry, we understand what exactly your legal firm requires. LegalTech ME has been created to shed light on digitalization and the massive changes happening in the industry, with the help of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence.

With expertise and knowledge of both IT and legal sector, we provide as well as develop software and building solutions, along with other areas of practice such as legal expertise and knowledge, legal IT solutions, legal research and development, legal training, data migration, and more.

about_short_description.short_description: LegalTech ME is a specialized legal technology service provider to create a digital transformation in the legal industry

product.name: Legal IT Solutions
product.description: Provides legal firms with IT expertise to initiate digital transformation and automation in their operations.

product.name: Technical Solutions
product.description: Delivers secure technical services including data encryption, third-party verification, and data backup with geographical redundancy for legal data protection.

product.name: Software Development
product.description: Develops custom legal software systems and applications to automate workflows and enhance firm deliverables.

product.name: Legal Data Migration
product.description: Facilitates the transfer of legal case data from spreadsheets or other systems to new platforms, ensuring confidentiality and smooth transition.

product.name: Legal Software Training
product.description: Provides professional training to legal professionals to effectively use legal software systems and maximize their benefits.

product.name: Legal Technology Research
product.description: Conducts research on legal technology trends, case studies, and client feedback to inform technology implementation strategies.
